plan.title: Kidney treated vs control DE with batch covariate
plan.analytical_narrative: The input is a raw salmon gene-level count matrix (12,000 genes x 12 samples, counts.csv, gene symbols in the first column) with a 12 x 3 sample table (metadata.csv) giving condition (treated vs control, 6 each) and two processing batches, each batch holding both conditions. The batch is known and balanced, so it belongs in the model as a fixed-effect term (~ batch + condition) rather than being regressed out of the counts before testing — adjusting counts and then testing them inflates confidence. The plan runs: (T1S1) sample-structure QC on a blind VST — PCA on the top 500 variable genes coloured by condition and by batch, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes — to see whether batch or condition drives the primary axis and whether any of the 12 samples is an outlier, before any test. (T1S2) DESeq2 Wald test on ~ batch + condition with control as the explicit reference level, minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least 6 samples, the smallest group size), median-of-ratios size factors estimated inside the model, apeglm shrinkage of the condition_treated_vs_control coefficient, BH adjustment with independent filtering at alpha 0.05. With 6 per group DESeq2 flags Cook's-distance outliers and returns NA p-values rather than replacing counts, so the step reports those NAs separately from independent-filter NAs. (T1S3) an edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same counts and the same design as an independent robustness check; the intersection is the high-confidence set, method-unique genes are reported as secondary, and the union is not presented as the result. (T2S1) preranked fgsea on the full list of tested genes ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark — a ranked test rather than an over-representation test on a thresholded list, because gene length and expression bias the latter. No reference store is provisioned at planning time and the package inventory could not be read, so every step must probe its packages and its gene sets before use; the enrichment step is annotation, not the answer to the research question, and must report cleanly that no gene-set collection was resolvable rather than fabricate one. (T2S2) assembles the reproducibility report. With n=6 per group this design is adequately powered for moderate effects but not for small ones; the report states the thresholds and the counts, not a biological story.

steps.description: Assemble a single report from T1S1, T1S2, T1S3, and T2S1. State, before any gene table: the method (DESeq2 Wald with apeglm shrinkage; edgeR QL as the second method), the version of every package used, the design formula ~ batch + condition, the contrast (condition, treated over control), the thresholds (padj < 0.05, BH, independent filtering on, minimal pre-filter of 10 counts in 6 samples), the number of genes tested after filtering out of the 12,000 input genes, and the number of differentially expressed genes per method with the size of their intersection. Then present the high-confidence intersection gene table ranked by shrunken absolute log2 fold change, the method-unique genes as a secondary set, the QC conclusion on batch versus condition structure from T1S1, and the enrichment section with its gene-set database and version, the ranking metric, the universe, and the size window. Attach session information. State plainly: the enrichment result depends on the method chosen; six replicates per group supports moderate but not small effects; the batch was balanced across conditions and modelled as a covariate rather than removed from the counts; and if few or no genes reached significance, say so without reframing.
steps.context: Closing step. Its job is a decision-ready, reproducible statement of what was found and what was not — not a narrative.
constraints: Report the method, versions, design, contrast, thresholds, n tested and n DE before any gene table
Report the DESeq2 and edgeR counts and their intersection; do not present the union
State the enrichment database, version, ranking metric, universe, and size window; mark enrichment hits as hypotheses
Do not overstate: name the power limit at n=6 per group and report a null result as a null result
Attach session info with package versions
acceptance_criteria: Report opens with method, package versions, design formula, contrast, thresholds, n tested, n DE per method, and the intersection size
High-confidence intersection gene table and secondary method-unique table both included
Enrichment section reports database, version, rank metric, universe, size window, and the method-dependence caveat
Session information attached
An explicit limitations paragraph covering replicate number, batch handling, and any NA/outlier-flagged genes
caveats: If T2S1 could not resolve a gene-set collection, the report must say so rather than omit the enrichment section silently

grounding.reason: Report names method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested and n DE (R-0041), the two-method overlap as the high-confidence set (R-0042), the enrichment provenance (R-0051), and the method-dependence of enrichment (R-0055).
